As we discussed last week, I've generated transit routes with three hours of flexibility around the requested departure/arrival time. This gives us a _lot_ more data for each trip. Here I take a look at some of these.

```{julia}
using DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, CSV, DataFramesMeta, StatsBase, Plots, Dates, ColorSchemes, StatsPlots, Tyler, CairoMakie, ArchGDAL

const TBI_DIR = "/mnt/c/Users/mwbc/University of Kentucky/VMT Reduction Mode Shift - General/Data_Processed"
const DATA_DIR = "/home/mwbc/vmt-output"
```

```{julia}
tbi = CSV.read(joinpath(TBI_DIR, "tbi_cleaned.csv"), DataFrame);
```

```{julia}
transit_trips = GeoDataFrames.read(joinpath(DATA_DIR, "transit_flexibility_10k.parquet"));
```

## How many trips does the average transit trip request have?

This is only among trips that routed successfully.

```{julia}
@chain transit_trips begin
    groupby(:trip_id)
    combine(nrow=>:n)
    median(_.n)
    "$(_) total trips ($(360/_) minute average frequency)"
end
```

## Check some example trips

```{julia}
function single_trips(legs)
    # format this into a form we can use - just the start and end time for each option,
    # and the sequence of routes
    @chain legs begin
        groupby(:option_index)
        @combine(:start_time=Time(first(:start_time)), :end_time=Time(last(:end_time)), :route_seq=join(skipmissing(coalesce.(:route_short_name, :route_long_name)), ", "))
    end
end

function mareyplot(legs)
    # find the trip in the TBI
    tbi_trip = tbi[tbi.trip_id .== first(legs.trip_id), :]
    @assert nrow(tbi_trip) == 1

    arrive_by = tbi_trip[1, :d_purpose_category] == "Work"
    time = tbi_trip[1, arrive_by ? :arrive_time : :depart_time]

    plot(legend=:outerbottomright, xlabel="Hours from requested $(arrive_by ? "arrival" : "departure")")

    plot_data = single_trips(legs)

    colors = Dict{String, RGB{Float64}}()

    for trip in eachrow(plot_data)
        include_in_legend = !haskey(colors, trip.route_seq)
        if include_in_legend
            colors[trip.route_seq] = ColorSchemes.tab20[length(colors) % 20 + 1]
        end
        
        plot!([Dates.value(Second(trip.start_time - time)) / 3600, Dates.value(Second(trip.end_time - time)) / 3600], [0, 1], color=colors[trip.route_seq], label=include_in_legend ? trip.route_seq : nothing)
    end

    plot!(yticks=[0, 1], yformatter=x->["Departure", "Arrival"][round(Int64, x) + 1])
end
```


```{julia}
mareyplot(transit_trips[transit_trips.trip_id .== first(transit_trips.trip_id), :])
```

```{julia}
mareyplot(transit_trips[transit_trips.trip_id .== "[1811424402035, 1811424402036, 1811424402037, 1811424402038]", :])
```

```{julia}
function print_trips(legs)
    @chain legs begin
        @subset :leg_type .== "TransitRouter.transit"
        @eachrow!(begin
            @newcol :text::Vector{String}
            :text = "$(:origin_stop_name)@$(Time(:start_time)) -> $(:destination_stop_name)@$(Time(:end_time)) via $(coalesce(:route_short_name, :route_long_name))"
        end)
        groupby(:option_index)
        @combine(:text = join(:text, ", "))
        println(join(_.text, "\n"))
    end
end
```

```{julia}
print_trips(transit_trips[transit_trips.trip_id .== "[1811424402035, 1811424402036, 1811424402037, 1811424402038]", :])
```

```{julia}
function option_frequencies(legs)
    trips = single_trips(legs)

    headway = []
    routeseq = []

    for group in groupby(trips, :route_seq)
        group = sort(group, :start_time)
        headways = Dates.value.(Second.(group.start_time[begin + 1:end] .- group.start_time[begin:end - 1]))
        push!.(Ref(headway), headways)
        push!.(Ref(routeseq), [first(group.route_seq) for _ in headways])

        # Handle trips that only come once
        if nrow(group) == 1
            push!(headway, 0)
            push!(routeseq, first(group.route_seq))
        end
    end

    StatsPlots.boxplot(routeseq, headway ./ 60, legend=false, xlabel="Option", ylabel="Headway (minutes)")
end

option_frequencies(transit_trips[transit_trips.trip_id .== "[1811424402035, 1811424402036, 1811424402037, 1811424402038]", :])
```


```{julia}
function both_plots(trip_id=nothing)
    while trip_id == nothing
        new_trip_id = rand(tbi.trip_id) # use tbi so longer trips are not overselected
        if new_trip_id ∈ transit_trips.trip_id
            trip_id = new_trip_id
        end
    end

    println(trip_id)

    legs = transit_trips[transit_trips.trip_id .== trip_id, :]

    freq = option_frequencies(legs)
    marey = mareyplot(legs)

    plot(freq, marey, layout=(2, 1), size=(800, 800))
end
```

```{julia}
both_plots("[1811424402035, 1811424402036, 1811424402037, 1811424402038]")
```
